title: SDSS9 color
credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service

geometryEvidence.reference: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC3368 = PGC 32192: inclination 51.07°, major-axis position angle 4.57°, from its outline at 25 mag per square arcsecond. Which edge of the disc is nearer is not in the source: the disc is drawn with the edge at position angle 95° nearer, an assumption.

displayModel: The photograph lies on one flat plane, the disc's midplane, as the Milky Way's backing image does. Nothing in the image has depth.
coverage: Milky Way foreground stars (Gaia DR3) are removed where they show; fainter and uncatalogued stars remain.

acquisition.operation: Request the cutout from the CDS hips2fits service: 3000 x 3000 px, 0.22 degrees wide, tangent projection on 161.690407, +11.819923, north up; no crop or resample.
